text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув finishes her training for the
day.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Phew... You head home first. I'd like to
spend
some time alone.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув
choice_data_list: Are you going to do some solo practice?

text_block_list.text:
Yes. I need to address a few points that
were
bothering me.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Are you going to quibble about how I
use my free
time?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув
choice_data_list: I'll use my free time to join you.
I'd like you to get a proper rest.

text_block_list.text: As ridiculous as ever, I see.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: But do as you please. It's your own time.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I understand what you're saying, but I
know my
limits better than anyone.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I have deemed myself capable of a little
more
training, so I'd prefer if you keep
such
unnecessary comments to yourself.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
You're going to concoct a regimen that
won't
leave me with any energy for solo
practice, huh?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Very well! If that's what you have in
store for me,
I'll go easy on today's extra
training.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
You'd better have a new regimen for me
by our
next training session. Are we
clear?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Having agreed to make a training
regimen more
suited to Эйр Грув's
wishes, we finish up for the
day.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I stick with Эйр Грув until she finishes
up her
solo practice.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
